messages:
customer-jones: Hey team — since goliath-v1 went live this morning we've seen a massive p95 jump on /v1/generate for some customers. Avg request: long-form doc summarization (~18k chars). p95 from ~4s -> ~13s, p99 is intermittent up to 22s. Any ideas?

rachel-support: thanks for flagging. Can you paste a minimal repro request and confirm the exact model tag you saw this against? Also any client-side changes?

customer-jones: model=goliath-v1, endpoint=/v1/generate. Here's a trimmed repro curl (single request that reproduces on our side):

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"goliath-v1","input":"<~18k chars of meeting transcript...>","max_tokens":4096,"stream":false}'
```

sandeep-eng-ml: looking. We pushed a tokenizer boundary rewrite as part of goliath onboarding (better subword packing). Hypothesis: new boundaries create many more small tokens for some long-form doc patterns, increasing KV cache churn and the service hitting slow path. Need token counts + per-request tokenization histogram.

lucy-eng-runtime: attaching quick scrape from canary logs (snippet):

```
[run-2378] request_id=rx-11 tokens_pre=1820 tokens_post=4860 kv_misses=1723 token_emit_latency.p50=3ms p95=220ms p99=1.1s
[run-2379] request_id=rx-12 tokens_pre=1808 tokens_post=5092 kv_misses=2011 token_emit_latency.p50=3ms p95=450ms p99=2.3s
```

You can see per-token emit p95 spikes when tokens_post > ~4.8k. KV miss rate correlates with throughput drop.

sandeep-eng-ml: confirms correlation. Two immediate mitigations: 1) toggle tokenizer compat mode (revert to legacy boundaries) per request via header X-Tokenizer-Compat: v1 — non-disruptive and can be canaried; 2) fallback model variant with conservative packing. Longer-term: tweak packing heuristic and update KV cache sizing.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for goliath-v1 with header override (X-Tokenizer-Compat: v1) in region us-west-2 — 10% traffic.  (deploy id: dpl-202631)

rachel-support: @customer-jones if you can try adding header X-Tokenizer-Compat: v1 (we can also enable for your org) can you report p95/p99 after that? We'll keep you posted on rollback window if needed. :eyes:

customer-jones: added header — p95 improved to ~2.9s on a few tries (nice) but p99 still hits ~9s occasionally on very long single-turn inputs. Looks better though, thanks.

lucy-eng-runtime: for the residual tail we're seeing, runtime mitigation we can flip now: chunk streaming (emit partial responses as we generate) + a per-request sequence cap (truncate/stream at 2048 token chunks) to avoid long blocking KV cycle. I can push a config toggle to Dedicated/Hosted to enable chunking for goliath-v1 canary. That should drop tail without rollback.

sandeep-eng-ml: agree. Plan: 1) enable X-Tokenizer-Compat v1 for affected orgs as short-term; 2) enable runtime chunk-streaming and per-request chunk cap for goliath-v1 canary; 3) collect token histograms and KV miss metrics for 48h; 4) patch packing heuristic and run small eval suite to verify quality/regression. Assign to eng-ml + eng-runtime.

rachel-support: filing internal ticket RW-12578 and customer-facing incident RW-12578-CJ. I'll link logs and the curl repro. ETA for toggles: 30m.

ops-bot: RW-12578 scheduled action: apply header override for org=cj-acct (owner: rachel-support) at 2026-04-12T15:40:00Z.

customer-jones: appreciate the quick turnaround. Please keep us in the loop on permanent fix cadence.

rachel-support: will do. closing loop for now but will update thread with post-mortem and final mitigation notes once eng posts them. :thumbsup:
